fields.description: Number of working days in a month used for salary calculation
fields.label: Working Days

fields.description: Official check-in time. Check-ins after this time plus late threshold are marked Late
fields.label: Office Start Time

fields.description: Minutes after office start time within which a check-in is still considered on time
fields.label: Late Threshold (Minutes)

fields.description: Number of late entries equal to one day deduction (e.g. 3 Late = 1 Day)
fields.label: Late Count for 1 Day Deduction

fields.description: Days deducted from salary per absent day (1 = full day salary)
fields.label: Absent = Day Deduction

fields.description: Days deducted from salary per half day (0.5 = half day salary)
fields.label: Half Day = Day Deduction

fields.description: If total working hours are at least this value but a full day was not worked, attendance is marked Half Day
fields.label: Half Day Working Hours

fields.description: Automatically mark employees Absent when they have no check-ins and no leave for a working day
fields.label: Auto Mark Absent

fields.description: Expense account used when salary is paid (e.g. Salary Expense / Payroll Expenses)
fields.label: Salary Expense Account

fields.description: Liability account salaries pass through (e.g. Salary Payable / Payroll Payable)
fields.label: Salary Payable Account

fields.description: Default account used when payment method is Bank
fields.label: Default Bank Account

fields.description: Default account used when payment method is Cash
fields.label: Default Cash Account
Accounting Help
fields.options: Accounts must belong to the selected Company. Bank / Cash accounts should be of account type Bank or Cash. These settings are used behind the scenes when the HR user clicks Pay Salary - a Journal Entry (accrual) and a Payment Entry (payment) are created automatically in ERPNext.
